title: Feasibility study: in-field electrical self-fingerprint of the board (TSC capacitance of display/SE nets, PDN response via ADC+TIM stimulus, panel-rail current) enrolled at the RDP-0 verification and re-checked before unlock
threat: Hardware implants and probes the firmware cannot see: a passive tap on the LCD SPI (the Grand/Nano X implant class — the display is a plaintext sink even though the device is otherwise all-internal-flash), an EM/laser FI probe parked over the package, a swapped PCB or added IC — all invisible to measured boot, option-byte checks and SE attestation.
proposal: Run a bench study on pq1 silicon (not an EVT change first): (1) STM32U585 TSC charge-transfer counts on candidate nets that can be sampled without a dedicated electrode (LCD SCK/MOSI/CS PA5/PA7/PA4 between frames, SE I2C lines during bus idle, the NC pins PA6/PC13), temperature-compensated with the internal temp sensor; (2) ADC1/ADC4 sampling of VDD/VDDA ripple while the consumption-mask TIM drives a known stimulus — a cheap on-chip proxy for ImpedanceVerif's PDN response; (3) if the EVT allows, a sense resistor on the LCM_EN/backlight rail read by ADC (panel-rail current signature vs. an added load). Enrol the baseline during the first-boot ceremony (after the user's SWD verification and before RDP-2), seal it in page 127/SE, and compare at boot and before each sign with a Wasserstein/Fréchet distance; a large distance refuses to unlock (never wipes — FPR is unknown). Deliverable is a go/no-go with measured intra-unit drift vs. probe-clip/implant deltas.
rationale: This is the only mechanism in the literature by which a device can notice an implant or a probe from the inside, and no vendor ships it; the user explicitly asked for it. The U585 already has the peripherals (TSC, ADC, COMP, OPAMP, TIM) and pq1 already owns a secure TIM stimulus source (consumption mask). Honest limit stated up front: a self-enrolled baseline cannot catch an implant inserted BEFORE enrolment — which is exactly why enrolment must sit after the RDP-0 verify-before-first-power step and why BOOT-04 (per-unit factory PDN/Z-profile with a VNA, offline) is the complementary supply-chain half.

vendor_precedent: none shipped. Academic: ImpedanceVerif (TCHES 2023, on-chip PDN impedance tamper detection), PDNPulse (IEEE TIFS 2023, offline VNA golden profiles, 100% TPR/0% FPR on PoC boards, per-batch FPR caveat), NAIST IEICE HWS2021-50 (on-IC capacitance sensors re-identify individual PCBs). Coldcard's SE-enforced genuine LED and GridPlus LDS mesh are the only shipped physical-integrity signals and neither detects a passive bus tap.
risks: Unvalidated as a security self-test; temperature/aging drift will dominate unless compensated; a sophisticated implant can be tuned below the detection floor (PDNPulse needed a bench VNA for fF sensitivity); refusing to unlock on a false positive is a usability failure (never wipe on this signal). Needs EVT pins for any rail sensing (PA6/PC13 are the only candidates).
